scope.CLIP: Mask-pallet presence readout is an external-occlusion proxy, not physical owner/causal gold.
scope.V61: Saved fixed threshold .5 center-pixel target-presence; D=present,E=absent,U=invalid. Semantic D/E transfer proxy, not real target-pixel accuracy.
scope.legacy: Existing real-CAL-trained reference; distinct training provenance from SYN-only experiments.
scope.primary: Human native D/E common PRIMARY1237; SELF/OOB/unannotated/mapping-unknown separate
scope.query_display: All panel image markers use same frozen historical q only. VIS_ONLY/JOINT classify new raw-model native slots and do not consume those q coordinates. New coordinates are separate numeric fields and never substituted into shared display.
scope.repeated_real_set: Existing repeatedly examined223 development images, not new independent real validation.
